chunks: And by this chain, he said: Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The most diligent of the people in rituals is the one most sincere in advising them, and the most submissive of them in hearts to the entirety of the Muslims.

key_terms.أَنْصَحُهُمْ: Most sincere in advising or giving counsel
key_terms.نُسُكاً: Diligence in rituals or acts of worship

ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics of the best Muslim according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni uses this hadith to establish the triad of ritual devotion, sincere counsel, and communal harmony as the markers of true piety. The term 'ansakh' (most sacrificial) is interpreted by Shia scholars as indicating a willingness to give of oneself for the community, while 'aslama qalbahu' signifies a heart free from malice and envy towards fellow Muslims. This underscores the Shia emphasis on 'nasihah' not merely as verbal advice, but as an internal state of purity that manifests in social conduct.

en.hubeali: And by this chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
The most diligent of the people in rituals is the one most sincere in advising them, and the most submissive of them in hearts to the entirety of the Muslims’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is reported through the same chain of narrators who has said the following: “The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘
The most assiduous worshipper among the people is the one whose inner center is most clean and whose heart is most peaceful toward Muslims.’”
